list.subtitle: {{count}} employees
list.searchPlaceholder: Search number, name, email, device id…
list.emptyHint: Add employees one by one or import them from a CSV file. They are pushed to your devices automatically.

fields.managerHint: Line manager: sees this employee's attendance and leave as a direct report and approves their requests.
fields.secondaryManagerHint: Dotted-line manager: also sees this employee as a direct report and is the backup approver when the manager is absent.
fields.weeklyOffDaysHint: Leave empty to inherit from the branch / organisation.
fields.deviceUserIdAuto: Leave blank to auto-assign the next free numeric id for this organisation.
fields.deviceUserIdEditHint: Changing the id re-pushes the employee to every device.
fields.pinHint: 4–8 digits; stored hashed and never shown again.
fields.workLocationHint: Where the employee works inside the branch: a site, floor or zone.

form.newHint: Create the employee record; device enrolment happens when the record is pushed to devices.
form.employmentHint: Where and how the employee works. These fields are effective-dated.
form.employmentEditHint: Changing branch, department, designation, manager, type or status asks for an effective date and closes the current employment record.
form.deviceHint: How the employee is recognised on attendance devices.

effective.title: Effective date of this change
effective.hint: The current employment record is closed and a new one starts from this date. Attendance is recalculated from that day.
effective.dateInvalid: Must be a valid date on or after {{min}}

bulk.queuedHint: Follow the push job in Sync jobs.
bulk.syncHint: A push job is queued for every device the employees should be enrolled on.

assign_branch.title: Assign branch ({{count}})
assign_branch.hint: Moves the selected employees to a branch. Effective-dated; devices are re-pushed.

assign_department.title: Assign department ({{count}})
assign_department.hint: Sets the department of the selected employees.
assign_department.clearHint: Leave empty to remove the department.

assign_shift.title: Assign shift ({{count}})
assign_shift.hint: Closes open employee shift assignments and starts a new one.
assign_shift.none: No shifts found. Create shifts first.
assign_shift.effectiveToHint: Included: the shift still applies on this day. Leave empty for no end.

set_status.title: Set status ({{count}})
set_status.hint: Changes the employment status. Termination removes the employees from devices.

assign_manager.title: Assign manager ({{count}})
assign_manager.hint: Sets who the selected employees report to.

export.title: Export employees
export.hint: A file is generated in the background; sensitive columns are masked unless you may view them.

assignManager.hint: The line manager sees these employees' attendance and leave as their team and approves their requests.

lines.primaryHint: Solid line: team visibility, approvals and the org chart.
lines.secondaryHint: Also sees them as direct reports and is the backup approver.

assignManager.removeHint: They will report to nobody from the effective date. People with no manager and no reports appear under Unassigned on the org chart.
assignManager.removeSecondaryHint: The dotted line is removed at once; the line manager stays.
assignManager.effectiveHint: The employment history records the new manager from this date.
assignManager.promoteHint: Anyone whose secondary manager is the new line manager has that dotted line promoted to the solid line.
assignManager.secondaryNow: The secondary manager changes at once; it is not part of the employment history.

why.already: They already report to this person.
why.alreadySecondary: This person is already their line manager or secondary manager.

assignManager.replacesOutside_one: {{count}} person reports to a manager outside this view of the org chart (another branch or department); that reporting line will be replaced.
assignManager.replacesOutside_other: {{count}} people report to a manager outside this view of the org chart (another branch or department); that reporting line will be replaced.
assignManager.cycleTitle: That would make a reporting loop
assignManager.cycle: The chosen manager already reports to {{names}}, directly or through other managers. Remove them from the selection, or pick another manager.

orgChart.title: Org chart
orgChart.subtitle: Who reports to whom across the organisation. Find a person, open a team, or rearrange reporting lines.
orgChart.levelError: This team could not be loaded.
orgChart.dragHint: Drag a card onto another person to change who they report to, or use the ⋯ menu on a card.

unassigned.title: Unassigned
unassigned.hint: People with no manager in this view of the chart and nobody reporting to them.
unassigned.hintEdit: No manager in this view of the chart and no direct reports. Drag a person onto their manager, or select people and assign a manager.
unassigned.selectAllFree: Select all shown who have no manager
unassigned.outsideManager: Reports to someone outside this view
unassigned.notListed: The person you looked for is not in this list any more: they may have been given a manager meanwhile.

addReports.title: Add direct reports to {{name}}
addReports.hint: The people you choose will report to {{name}} as their line manager, replacing their current manager from the effective date.

move.title: Change manager?
move.outsideManager: {{employee}} currently reports to a manager outside this view of the org chart (another branch or department); that reporting line will be replaced.

remove.title: Remove the manager of {{name}}?
remove.description: {{name}} will report to nobody from the effective date.
remove.descriptionSecondary: The dotted line from {{name}} to {{manager}} is removed at once.

dnd.self: A person cannot report to themselves.
dnd.cycle: {{manager}} is in {{employee}}'s own team, so {{employee}} cannot report to them. Pick someone outside that team.

focus.notOnChart: This person is not on the chart: they left, or they are outside the branch or department shown.

empty.noLinesHint_one: {{count}} person has no manager yet. Build the chart in any of these ways:
empty.noLinesHint_other: {{count}} people have no manager yet. Build the chart in any of these ways:
empty.wayDrag: Open Unassigned and drag a person onto their manager.
empty.wayAddReports: Open Unassigned and use “Add direct reports…” in a person's ⋯ menu.
empty.wayBulk: On the Employees list, select people and choose Assign… → Assign manager.
empty.wayImport: Import a CSV with the managerEmployeeNumber column.
empty.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to assign managers.
empty.noEmployeesHint: Add employees first; the chart is drawn from each employee's manager.
empty.noLinesInView: No reporting lines in this view
empty.noLinesInViewHint_one: {{count}} person in this view has no manager inside it; they may report to someone in another branch or department. To build the chart here:
empty.noLinesInViewHint_other: {{count}} people in this view have no manager inside it; some may report to someone in another branch or department. To build the chart here:

history.emptyHint: History rows are created automatically when employment details change.

devices.hint: Desired state per device. Failed items retry automatically; use Sync now to force a push.
devices.emptyHint: The employee is pushed to the devices of their branch when a sync runs.

attendance.emptyHint: Records appear once punches are processed.
attendance.unavailableHint: Open the attendance page for this employee's records.

activity.title: Activity history
activity.subtitle: Where the day went: hours inside, hours in the field.

stats.fieldHint: {{percent}}% of the time between first and last punch

chart.title: Hours per day
chart.hint: Green is time in the office, blue is time away between the first and the last punch. The dashed line is the scheduled day.
chart.hintAway: Green is time on site. The time away between the first and the last punch is split the way it was classified: official duty, personal permission, break or unapproved. The dashed line is the scheduled day.
chart.empty: No attendance recorded in this period
chart.emptyHint: Records appear once punches are processed. Try another period.

timeline.title: Day heartbeat
timeline.hint: Every day on the same clock: green while inside, blue while out of the office.

table.title: Details
table.hint: The numbers behind the chart, day by day.

stats.awayHint: {{percent}}% of the time between first and last punch
stats.unapprovedHint: Away beyond the breaks without an approved request

documents.addHint: Identity documents are sensitive: numbers are visible only to users with the view-sensitive permission.
documents.auditNotice: Every view of this tab is recorded in the audit log.
documents.restrictedHint: You need the “view sensitive data” permission to see identity documents.
documents.emptyHint: Add civil id, passport or labour card details.
documents.deleteHint: The deletion is audited. This cannot be undone.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.hint: Destructive actions are audited and require confirmation.
danger.archiveHint: Marks the employee as terminated, sets the exit date and removes them from all devices. Attendance history is kept.
danger.confirmHint: The employee is removed from devices and hidden from lists. This can only be reversed by support.

import.title: Import employees
import.subtitle: Upload a CSV, review validation results, then confirm. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.templateHint: Download the CSV template with the exact column headers. Codes (branch, department, designation) must match existing records.
import.uploadHint: CSV only (UTF-8, comma/semicolon/tab). Up to 5,000 rows and 20 MB.
import.chooseFile: Choose a CSV file or drop it here
import.updateExistingHint: Rows matching an existing employee number update that record instead of being reported as duplicates.
import.autoAssignHint: Rows without a device user id get the next free numeric id.
import.confirmHint: {{valid}} rows will be imported; {{invalid}} rows with errors are skipped.
import.nothingValid: No valid rows — fix the file and upload again.
import.confirmDescription: Employees are created in the background and pushed to devices. Rows with errors are skipped.
import.queuedHint: Employees are being created in the background. Follow progress in Sync jobs.
